title: Letter From Mr. M. Ankudinoff, Melbourne, Australia

July 16 37.

Michael Ankudinoff, Esq.,
101 Abbotford Str.,
Melbourne,
Australia.

Sir,

With reference to your letter dated
July 1, 1937, I have to inform you that the
addresses of your brother and sister in Shanghai
are as follows :-

Mr. V. G. Ankudinoff, 19 Route Vallon.
Mrs. M. Tonkin, 956/A.10 Rue Bourgeat.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner of Police
in Charge.

1937年7月16日。

Michael Ankudinoff 先生，
澳大利亚，
墨尔本，
Abbotford 街 101 号。

先生：

关于您 1937 年 7 月 1 日的来信，兹通知您，您的兄弟和姐妹在上海的地址如下：

V. G. Ankudinoff 先生，华伦路（Route Vallon）19 号。
M. Tonkin 夫人，布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）956/A.10 号。

此致，
敬礼

（签名）K. M. Bourne
代理警务处长

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date July 16, 19 37

Subject Letter from Mr. M. Ankudinoff, Melbourne, Australia, requesting information regarding his relations in Shanghai.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C Crawford

Enquiries show that Mr. M. Ankudinoff, the writer of the attached letter, has one brother and four sisters in Shanghai, namely:-

1. Mr. V.G. Ankudinoff , 19 Route Vallon.
2. Mrs M. Tonkin , 956/ A 10 Rue Bourgeat.
3. Mrs Lily Walter, 163/23 Route de Grouchy ( Savoy Apartments)
4. Mrs Liza Lucas , 19 Route Vallon
5. Mrs Mary Joergens, Savoy Apartments, Route de Say Zoong.

Mr. M. Tonkin, British, of the Polish Import & Export Co.,Ltd, 320 Szechuen Road, who furnished the above information, stated that some time ago his wife ( maiden name Ankudinoff) requested Mr.V.G. Bowden, Australian Trade Commissioner for China, to institute enquiries in Australia regarding the whereabouts of her brother, Michael Ankudinoff, who was believed to reside in that country. In result of these enquiries an individual named Michael Ankudinoff was located in Melbourne. He wrote to Mr. M. Tonkin c/o Mr. V.G. Bowden and gave his address as 101 Abbotford Str., Melbourne.

However, the contents of the letters received aroused the suspicions of Mrs Tonkin and her sisters that the writer of these letters was not their brother, but some other person who was not at all associated with the family. Therefore, they expect from would-be Michael Ankudinoff further proofs of his identity.

Mr. M. Tonkin has no objection to his address being communicated to Mr. M. Ankudinoff.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C. ( Special Branch)
8/BR 16/7

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
特务科第一股
报告
日期：1937 年 7 月 16 日

事由：澳大利亚墨尔本 M. Ankudinoff 先生来函，查询其在上海亲属的情况。

由警探长 Prokofiev 呈报。经 C Crawford 转递。

经查，附件信函的写信人 M. Ankudinoff 先生在上海有一名兄弟和四名姐妹，即：

1. V.G. Ankudinoff 先生，华伦路（Route Vallon）19 号。
2. M. Tonkin 夫人，布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）956/ A 10 号。
3. Lily Walter 夫人，格鲁希路（Route de Grouchy）163/23 号（萨伏伊公寓）
4. Liza Lucas 夫人，华伦路（Route Vallon）19 号
5. Mary Joergens 夫人，赛宗路（Route de Say Zoong）萨伏伊公寓。

四川路 320 号波兰进出口有限公司（Polish Import & Export Co.,Ltd）的英籍人士 M. Tonkin 先生提供了上述信息，并称前一段时间，其妻子（娘家姓 Ankudinoff）曾请求澳大利亚驻华贸易专员 V.G. Bowden 先生在澳大利亚调查其兄弟 Michael Ankudinoff 的下落，据信其居住在该国。经此调查，在墨尔本找到了一位名为 Michael Ankudinoff 的人。此人通过 V.G. Bowden 先生转交致信 M. Tonkin 先生，并告知其地址为墨尔本 Abbotford 街 101 号。

然而，所收到信件的内容引起了 Tonkin 夫人及其姐妹的怀疑，她们认为这些信件的写信人并非她们的兄弟，而是与家庭毫无关联的其他人。因此，她们希望这位自称 Michael Ankudinoff 的人提供进一步的身份证明。

M. Tonkin 先生不反对将其地址告知 M. Ankudinoff 先生。

A. Prokofiev
警探长

警务副处长（特务科）
8/BR 16/7

1st July 1939
To Commissioner of Police in Shanghai
China
Sir
Could you Please locate my Sister
Ema Tomlin who are living in Shanghai
I am told that my Parents are dead & altho I have
Written Twice to my Sister in her married name
I can get no answer. I know that She would
Write to me if She received my letters my Brother
& all the rest of my family living with her thro'
Matter need urgent attention as there is money left to
Me so trusting you will have enquiries made &
Thanking you I am Sir
Yours faithfully Michael
Ankudinoff

Enclosed are
Full names & Birth 101 Abbotsford st.
& addresses given to me by North Melbourne
Sister one here who has Australia. Vict.
Also tried to get in touch
With them without result-

I am eldest brother in any
Australia Please reply to any
inquiry

My Brother Valay (Valten )
Ankudinoff
My Sister name Mary Dorgen
Tomlin. c/o Mr. V. G. Bowden,
Australian Trade Commission
for China
Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank
Corp. Ltd.
12 the Bund,
Shanghai
page_data.zh:
1939 年 7 月 1 日
致中国上海警务处处长
先生
能否请您查找我的姐妹
Ema Tomlin，她居住在上海
我得知我的父母已去世，虽然我已
两次以我姐妹的婚后姓名去信
但未获回复。我知道如果她收到我的信，她一定会
给我回信，我的兄弟
以及所有其他家人都和她住在一起，此事
需要紧急处理，因为有一笔钱留给了
我，相信您会进行调查，并
感谢您，此致
敬礼 Michael
Ankudinoff

附寄
全名及出生 101 Abbotsford 街
及北墨尔本（North Melbourne）给我的地址
此处有一位姐妹在澳大利亚。维多利亚州。
也曾试图联系
他们，但无结果——

我是长子，在任何
澳大利亚请回复任何
查询

我的兄弟 Valay (Valten )
Ankudinoff
我的姐妹名字 Mary Dorgen
Tomlin. 转交 V. G. Bowden 先生，
澳大利亚驻华贸易委员会
汇丰银行有限公司
（Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank Corp. Ltd.）
外滩 12 号，
上海
